hypothesis: A list of places or travel events remains a recommendation even when formatted or described as a guide/itinerary; reusable recipes, lessons, and exercise methods remain repertoire.
prompt_variant: Classify the content's purpose, not its format or label. A list of named venues, sights, shops, restaurants, events or destinations, including a travel guide or itinerary telling the viewer where to go, is mode=recommandation even when detailed and worth saving. Use mode=repertoire for reusable instructions, demonstrated recipes, exercises, skills or lessons that the viewer can perform or learn; the word guide alone does not make something a repertoire entry.

protocol.holdout_policy: Do not revise the variant after inspecting holdout scores. Any further prompt change requires a new untouched holdout fixture.
protocol.source_scope: Source text is read from the existing database and copied into a fresh temporary database; no production extraction or database writes.
